about: Global settings profile, sent by scripts/harness.py with every query (docs/benchmark-protocol.md, section 4). sql_compatibility is owned by role 3: the profile of ClickHouse's own TPC-DS benchmark (tests/benchmarks/tpc-ds/settings.json), plus except_default_mode and cast_keep_nullable (CAST of NULL gives NULL, as in SQL; fixes Q18 and Q61). Not prefer_column_name_to_alias: it fixes Q66 but breaks Q33, Q56, Q60 and Q71. benchmark is owned by role 2. Changing any setting means re-running every SF.
